Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 assays against human single-protein target CHEMBL1293295 (Ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase 14). Join molecule_dictionary to activities to assays to target_dictionary, then join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter for standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pchembl_value. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id. Do not deduplicate rows.
